manifest.purpose: Hardened implementation of extern "C" int run_transfer(Descriptor* desc, uint8_t* dest, uint32_t max_len) matching descriptor_transfer.h unchanged. Reads desc->length exactly once into a local non-volatile uint32_t snapshot at function entry, before any other access. Validates snapshot > max_len -> return -1 with zero bytes copied (dest untouched). Otherwise loop bound uses only the local snapshot (never re-reads desc->length), copying snapshot bytes from desc->data[0..snapshot-1] into dest[0..snapshot-1] in order, then returns static_cast<int>(snapshot). Handles snapshot==0 by copying nothing and returning 0 (valid zero-length transfer, distinct from rejection). No dynamic allocation, no extra includes beyond descriptor_transfer.h and <cstdint>. This satisfies FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR3: single read of desc->length, identical value used for check and copy, dest left unmodified on rejection, no OOB read/write regardless of concurrent mutation of desc->length after entry.
